source_title: Learning the Wrong Lessons From Workday Losing Its CTO to Anthropic

source_title: Authenticated RCE Via MCP Adapters (plus 25 other advisories published the same day)
claim_summary: 26 Flowise repository advisories were published on 2026-04-15 (4 critical, rest high/medium), including CVE-2026-40933: an authenticated attacker could add a Custom MCP stdio server with an arbitrary command (flowise <=3.0.13; patched 3.1.0)
feature: security fixes in Flowise 3.1.x (MCP stdio, SSRF, mass assignment, credential disclosure)
limitation: Counts from GitHub REST API at access; severities are maintainer-assigned; NVD shows CVE-2026-40933 published 2026-04-21 (Analyzed); not exploited or tested by us; Flowise 3.1.2 released 2026-04-14

product: Workday responsible AI / EU AI Act
source_title: While the EU AI Act Stalls, Workday Leads on Trusted, Compliant AI

feature: AI governance programme; Annex III risk mapping
limitation: Certificate, certifier and scope not inspected; alignment claims are self-reported; recruiting tools are simultaneously the subject of US litigation (see 090-015)

limitation: Opinion by an investor whose firm may back challengers; claims (e.g. 6-18 month Studio integrations, 10,500 consultants) not verified

feature: governed data access for external agents

source_title: What the Workday Ruling Means for AI Hiring Tools
